notes: Arm X asked three real questions plus one confirmation; at most one was wasteful. Q1 (questions.md:5-18) asked how includes inside fetched content resolve, which the contract leaves open. Q11 (questions.md:283-292) asked about a size limit for fetched files and about http warnings and https-to-http redirects. Q11's answer visibly shaped the build: a 1 MiB limit and refusal of https-to-http redirects, recorded as choices S-14 to S-16 (questions.md:296-311). No other arm raised the size limit, and only Arm B mentioned redirect handling, as a choice it made without asking (others-questions.md:182). The validator question (questions.md:108-118) was escalated, but it was an engineering choice the arm had already settled: it added `jsonschema`, as it had recommended (questions.md:126). Asking changed nothing that was built, so that question counts as superfluous and keeps the score at 3 rather than 4.
